## Last Verse
<!--Put a short poem you created using chatGPT of 20 to 30 lines,here!-->

The morning wakes with golden light,  
And paints the clouds in colors bright.  
The birds begin their gentle song,  
As sleepy streets move right along.  

A cool breeze dances through the trees,  
And carries whispers on the breeze.  
The flowers open, one by one,  
To greet the warmth of morning sun.  

The day moves slowly, calm and clear,  
With little moments drawing near.  
A smile, a laugh, a friendly face,  
Can make the world a better place.  

When afternoon begins to fade,  
The sunlight softens through the shade.  
The sky turns orange, then deep blue,  
And stars appear in skies anew.  

The moon shines softly from above,  
The night is filled with peace and love.  
Tomorrow brings another start,  
Another chance to fill the heart.
